name: convert_file
description: Convert Markdown or plain-text files directly to complete, formatted PDF documents, or convert media locally. Examples: "convert this .md file to PDF", "make a PDF from my uploaded Markdown", "convert my image to PNG", "convert video to MP3", "remove the white background from my image". Markdown/text PDF rendering reads the original UTF-8 source in full; no model summarization or ASCII workaround is needed. Markdown headings, lists, tables, code, clickable links, and Unicode punctuation are supported with bundled fonts. Markdown images embed validated rasters from stash:// references, public HTTP(S) URLs, inline data:image URLs, and relative paths confined to the original source file's directory. Private network URLs and absolute/file image paths are blocked. Animated GIFs render their first frame with a warning after full animation validation. Missing, blocked, unsupported, or over-limit images stay labeled placeholders with warnings. Also supports image formats, raster-to-SVG tracing, video/audio conversion, video-to-audio extraction, and solid edge-connected background removal. Accepts stash:// references or local files; outputs save to Stash for preview and download.

source.description: Source file: stash://space_id/file_id reference OR local file path

target_format.description: Target extension without dot: pdf for .md/.markdown/.txt documents; png, jpg, webp, gif, svg, mp4, webm, mp3, wav, flac, ogg, aac for supported media.

options.description: Optional conversion settings. PDF: title (document title); Markdown/text inputs must be UTF-8 and at most 5 MB. Full source is rendered without summarization. Image: quality (1-100), resize ("800x600" or "50%"), strip_metadata (bool). Video: crf (0-51), resolution, fps, duration. Audio: bitrate, sample_rate, channels. SVG: threshold. Solid-background removal: remove_background, background_color, background_tolerance; requires PNG/WebP and a single-frame raster input.

remove_background.description: Remove a solid edge-connected background while preserving enclosed matching colors. Default false. Use target_format png or webp. Not semantic subject segmentation.

background_color.description: With remove_background: auto (default) checks corner colors; or explicit #RRGGBB such as #FFFFFF.

background_tolerance.description: With remove_background: color tolerance percentage, default 5. Lower retains more detail; higher removes more similar edge-connected colors. Do not use high tolerance on white subjects.

title.description: Optional PDF document title. Unicode punctuation is supported; defaults to the source filename stem.
